88:t_029:13.en:
$n
「$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$... $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... A new $$スフィア・リアクター$$...」

88:t_030:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What's wrong, $$ランド・トラビス$$? Is that all your anger amounts to?」

88:t_030:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Heh... Your own awakening seems to be progressing, but the $$傷だらけの獅子$$ isn't answering it... Is there some reason?」

88:t_030:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shut up! You're my enemy, pal! You've got no right to say a word about me and $$ガンレオン$$!」

88:t_030:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Oh, never mind. Someday your $$スフィア$$ will gather under the $$サイデリアル$$ too. Until then, struggle all you like.」

88:t_100:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
(H-hurry...! I can't disgrace myself in front of that person!)

88:t_100:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
(One more failure and my life is in danger...!)

88:t_101:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I don't like it. It's as if you think you represent every light there is.」

88:t_101:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「This guy...! What the hell are you talking about!?」

88:t_101:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm not asking you to understand. Hurry up and get out of my sight.」

88:t_102:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Flitting around like that is annoying... I'll tear off those wings you're so proud of.」

88:t_102:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「What is this guy...!? Is he fighting on emotion alone?」

88:t_102:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What's wrong with that? I fight as my heart commands me, nothing more.」

88:t_103:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're piloting an interesting machine. It looks like it'd be worth killing.」

88:t_103:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「This guy is neither a soldier nor a warrior...! He's just like a child swinging his power around on emotion alone!」

88:t_103:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right. I'm just letting out the emotions that swirl inside me.」

88:t_104:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you think being a child means I'll go easy on you, you're badly mistaken.」

88:t_104:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't underestimate the great $$竹尾ワッ太$$! I've been fighting to protect the Earth too!」

88:t_104:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Protect? How absurd, fighting for the sake of others.」

88:t_105:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「When I smash that toy of yours right in front of you, what kind of cries will you make, I wonder.」

88:t_105:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't let you do that! $$鉄人$$ will never lose!」

88:t_105:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hearing that only makes me want to break it more. Your toy, and your heart too.」

88:t_106:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So the poison $$ティファ$$ talked about is you!」

88:t_106:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'll take on anyone who scares $$ティファ$$! Get ready, damn you!」

88:t_106:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I don't like you... You especially, I don't like...」

88:t_106:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Anyone who fights for someone else should just die... No, I'll kill you myself.」

88:t_107:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Scorpion or pork cutlet, whatever you are, you're the enemy boss!」

88:t_107:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I have no intention of dealing with a dimwitted brat. I'll have you gone right away.」

88:t_107:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Why, you...! Don't think the great $$勝平$$ goes down that easily!」

88:t_107:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Killing someone who thinks they alone will never die... That's not a bad way to spend time.」

88:t_108:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. The enemy unit is estimated to be a special type, even among the $$サイデリアル$$. Careless contact is dangerous.」

88:t_108:1.en:
$$レド$$
「But leaving him alone is even more dangerous! I'm moving in, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

88:t_108:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「A $$マシンキャリバー$$, built for group combat, acting alone. You're a stray dog cut off from the pack.」

88:t_108:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Just let me exterminate you already.」

88:t_109:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
(So it really is an enemy...? If so, then that means...)

88:t_110:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What a disappointment. The Reactors of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ are only this much.」

88:t_110:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was better than this. Maybe it's best to kill you quickly and bet on someone else awakening their $$スフィア$$.」

88:t_110:3.en:
$n
「I don't care about the Spheres' existence...」

88:t_110:4.en:
$n
「But that Sphere is what $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ gave me at the cost of his life! I won't forgive anyone who mocks it!」

88:t_110:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come to think of it, I heard that man died. Serves him right.」

88:t_110:6.en:
$n
「You...! Do you want to make me angry that badly!?」

88:t_110:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're small. If a few words like that can stir up your emotions, you can't beat the hatred inside me.」

88:t_111:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「A scorpion's poison and a butterfly's poison... I think you and I would get along.」

88:t_111:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Don't lump the $$ホワイトドール$$ together with something that spreads destruction like you!」

88:t_111:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Do you really mean that? Wasn't it the $$ターンタイプ$$ that spread destruction?」

88:t_111:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You know about the $$黒歴史$$...!?」

88:t_111:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The Moon Queen fulfilled her mission. The result of that is the butterfly's poison.」

88:t_111:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Nonsense...! I won't be fooled by words like that!!」

88:t_112:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Miss $$ソシエ$$, Miss $$キエル$$... I will definitely come back.)

88:t_112:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(And $$ディアナ$$... I will definitely use the power of the $$ホワイトドール$$ you entrusted to me for everyone's sake...!)

88:t_113:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It's been a while, $$ランド・トラビス$$. And $$メール・ビーター$$.」

88:t_113:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Been looking for you. Never thought you'd have crossed over to the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

88:t_113:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I wasn't running away from you two, you know. I have a mission of my own.」

88:t_113:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm not here to listen to your excuses...! You're going to pay for what you did!」

88:t_113:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If this is about $$クラヴィア$$, it's not my fault. That was her true self, after all.」

88:t_113:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shut up! Everybody's got something in their heart they can't show anyone!」

88:t_113:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「And the dirty bastard who forced it out of her, I'm gonna punch his lights out!!」

88:t_114:0.en:
$$メール$$
「Crashing right into the decisive battle like this, we're so lucky!」

88:t_114:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「You bet! Meet old acquaintances, liberate $$アメリア$$, and on top of that, punch $$バルビエル$$!」

88:t_114:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'll take care of it all at once! Full power, $$ガンレオン・マグナ$$!!」
